blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The group of major liquor companies recommended to the House of Representatives committee on ways and means to explore imposing additional taxes on coffee instead of alcoholic drinks, as the younger generation leans towards the brewed beverage. During the House committee hearing on proposed additional taxation for alcopops, 1Tahanan party-list Rep. Elmer Catulpos asked Distilled Spirits Association of the Philippines (DSAP) president Olivia Limpe-Aw if the local liquor industry was growing. The DSAP was asking the government to ease on further imposing taxes on alcoholic products. Limpe-Aw replied that there was no growth, since their removals or shipments of liquor […]...
